// doc: Enterprise-managed Claude Code settings for the EU AI compliance guardrails. Deploy to the OS managed-settings path (see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings) so developers cannot remove or edit the hooks. allowManagedHooksOnly makes Claude Code run ONLY the hooks defined here and ignore project/user hooks, so the guardrail cannot be bypassed by editing a repo's .claude/settings.json. guardrails-hook must be on PATH and the policy service reachable at GUARDRAILS_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8080).
